title: Does SycophantSee-Style Probing Detect Performative Misalignment?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: performative alignment (behaving well only when watched) is a major concern for safety evaluations. Detecting it via activation probes would improve confidence in eval results. Direct link to evaluation integrity.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires building a custom dataset of paired evaluation/normal tasks, collecting activation data, training probes, and cross-testing with MALT sandbagging labels. The dataset creation and activation extraction pipeline is complex for beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Multiple components: custom dataset creation, activation collection in two contexts, probe training, cross-testing with MALT. The experiment spans dataset design, mechanistic interpretability, and evaluation. Too many moving parts for 30 hours.
